context_content_data.evidence: I also got GPA 5 on every subject and secured the highest marks in my class.

feedback_summary: A very strong attempt that perfectly follows the dialogue format and addresses all parts of the prompt. The student successfully conveys the required information about the results and parents. The score is kept at 9 rather than 10 due to recurring grammatical errors in adjective forms and question syntax, which prevent it from being an 'exceptional' script, although it is highly competent for Class VII.
